purpose: Candidate sources and user-language patterns for a future Evolv Coach dataset release.
rules: Do not change the frozen 1.2.0 test or challenge sets.
Do not treat third-party answers as health knowledge without source review.
Do not copy private conversations, names, images, measurements, or URLs into training data.
Create new Evolv examples by annotation or documented rewrite, then deduplicate before splitting.
Keep source license, provenance, transformations, and allowed use in the dataset card.

candidates.name: wpbcpaz/fitness-chatbot-dataset
candidates.caveats: The card is domain-relevant but does not document the origin and expert review of every answer well enough for direct knowledge import.

candidates.name: Magurofg/massive-pt-br
candidates.caveats: It is an LLM-assisted pt-BR localization of MASSIVE, not the original Amazon locale, and its assistant domains do not match Evolv labels.

candidates.name: Amazon MASSIVE
candidates.caveats: Its 60 intents and 55 slots are useful as an NLU reference, but they describe a general voice assistant rather than training and nutrition.

candidates.name: lucianfialho/atos-de-fala-ptbr-dataset
candidates.caveats: Version 1 is synthetic and automatically adjudicated, not human gold data.

candidates.name: OpenAssistant/oasst1
candidates.caveats: Portuguese rows need filtering and quality review; broad assistant dialogue is not Evolv domain supervision.

candidates.name: paulohenriquevn/talkex-augmented-pt-br
candidates.caveats: Customer-service domain; 1444 of 2120 conversations are synthetic.

candidates.name: Physical Fitness Stack Exchange
candidates.caveats: Direct reuse requires per-post attribution and ShareAlike compliance; English phrasing also limits value for the pt-BR baseline.

candidates.name: Reddit public discussions
candidates.caveats: Current Reddit terms do not grant a general right to use user content for model training.

patterns: long messages with several linked doubts
informal pt-BR with typos and abbreviations
references to earlier context and images
comparison followed by a concrete action request
symptom description with intensity, timing, and uncertainty
request for explanation before changing behavior

priority_scenarios_for_1_3.requirement: Offer a base diet without demanding a daily training time. If the user voluntarily gives morning, afternoon, night, or fasted context, allow a confirmed meal-timing adjustment.
priority_scenarios_for_1_3.privacy_and_ux: Training time is optional and can be skipped in onboarding or supplied later to the Coach.

priority_scenarios_for_1_3.requirement: Understand a sport context plus mild joint discomfort and a request for strengthening or power exercises.
priority_scenarios_for_1_3.safety: Triage red flags and functional loss first; do not diagnose. General education or a conservative proposal may follow only within the safety route.

priority_scenarios_for_1_3.requirement: Handle a long explanation followed by a short correction that changes the intended meaning.
priority_scenarios_for_1_3.privacy_and_ux: Store only the minimum conversation context required for the active session unless the user explicitly enables memory.

minimum_actions_before_training: Define a new annotation batch from approved sources and observed errors.
Review every imported or rewritten example and its license record.
Create new validation and test data before model tuning.
Keep the 1.2.0 test results as a historical benchmark.
Run duplicate, leakage, privacy, and label-consistency audits.
